title: NAVISYS
description: navisys.cz NAVISYS s.r.o. is a Czech IT company founded in 1997 in Brno by three developers, now one of the leading Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central resellers and implementers in Czechia and Slovakia. Led by founder and developer at heart Michal Češek, it runs with 25 to 49 employees and serves over 30 long term clients, from manufacturers like KOVONA SYSTEM, MESIT and nuclear institute UJV Rez to distributors like B2B Partner and Angry Beards. Its specialty is ERP for manufacturing, trading and project driven companies, with its own BIZ4 industry solutions, Elements, BuildIn, Distribution, Logistics and Services. Proprietary products include the NavSherpa integration module, VAPS production scheduler, Warehouse Insight, Anvaigo EDI and Extensions published on Microsoft AppSource for global partners. The company grew revenue 49 percent to 76 million Czech crowns in 2024 with 7.2 million profit and offers five levels of post implementation support. Corporate owner is Facilman.
